notes.title: Version 0.4
notes.content:
[b]Tech Tree Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Added speed boost upgrade. Allows the player to walk faster.
[/list]

[b]UI Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Moved the action menu to the inside of enemy during battle. It was getting cut off on other resolutions.
[*] Added an option to change to windowed mode on title screen and in the settings.
[/list]

[b]Game Play Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] After winning a battle you will earn digital currency that can be used for purchases of various items.
[*] Added new wired vending machine to the West Side and Corporate elevator lobby. The vending allows purchase of drink that will instantly refill health and energy bars.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch V0.03
notes.content:
[b]Interface Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed controls instructions in settings/controls
[*] Added an arrow in battle mode indicating to click enemy to advance in battle
[/list]

[b]Apartment Update[/b]

[list]
[*] You can now recharge your health back at the apartment
[*] Added new sleeping scene and Lovense device actions
[/list]

[b]Battle Scene[/b]

[list]
[*] Added missing Lovense vibrations when lust action by enemy is being executed
[/list]
